scope: Spline electron sector eS5o. 3D Bayesian phi_h in the copy of fits/spline/electron_sector/eS5o/fit_copy.root, Q2-y 1-17. 421 fitted cells and 31 empty histograms. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D were absent and were not created. No publication. The source file, sector_fit_exclusions_20261106.json, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows have median width 0.0158 and 463 of 489 are narrower than 0.05, and the C windows are narrower (median 0.0073, 482 of 489 below 0.05), so they can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 used the manual baseline on all 421 histograms and the corrected first-to-last phi range. The manual limits and the halfway second pass left 11 histograms off the cosine those points support, and 15 more were still short of their own unconstrained cosine. Pass 2 put each of those starts on the better cosine, opened the limits so the start was not on the boundary, and refit Q2-y 1 2 3 5 6 8 9 10 11 13 14 15 16 17. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) stored B -0.045000 error 0.029851 chi-squared 6.353 NDF 7, retained B -0.058239 error 0.028111 C 0.001638 error 0.002141 chi-squared 6.266 NDF 7, phi 75-285, 14 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. Nominal B is -0.125184. The shift versus nominal is kept because it is this histogram's cosine. Excluded pairs were restored only when the manual pass was worse (0) and were not tuned to re-enter the budget. 18 histograms have a lower fair chi-squared than the stored fit, and none is worse than the better of the stored fit and the manual pass by more than 1. The stored TF1 range ran past the filled window in 26 histograms. After this refit, 0 range mismatches remain. JSON still has 421 bins. Q2-y 4 7 12 were not in pass 2 and match pass 1.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. RC_Bayesian and BC_RC_Bayesian are absent and were not created. Excluded pairs stay omitted. Missing comparisons stay missing, not zero. Shapes that disagree with the nominal were kept. Largest non-excluded |B| shifts versus the nominal spline Bayesian fit: (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_3) deltaB -0.229 (-31.7 stat), (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_15) deltaB 0.223 (6.8 stat), (Q2_y_Bin_8)-(z_pT_Bin_28) deltaB -0.173 (-10.9 stat). Fit-parameter uncertainties were not added to a systematic uncertainty.
unresolved: Further guide changes do not help bins whose retained curve already matches the unconstrained cosine. Empty histograms stay N/A and are not zeroes. (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_15) keeps |B| or |C| at or above 1 (B 1768547.820, C 947381.137) [excluded] and was not given a nominal value (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_22) keeps |B| or |C| at or above 1 (B -7.012, C -1.191) [excluded] and was not given a nominal value (Q2_y_Bin_8)-(z_pT_Bin_30) keeps |B| or |C| at or above 1 (B 236296.229, C -0.124) [excluded] and was not given a nominal value (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_19) has an isolated pull -4.26 at 82 degrees.
why_retained: The retained fit is better because every changed histogram follows its own points at least as well as the stored curve and the manual-only pass, and the TF1 range is the filled window instead of the old extension through empty bins. A nominal value was not copied onto a different shape.
